subject: Hourglass: Coding screen — final availability & debrief plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Zheng <sophia.zheng@example.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: TalentBridge Recruiter <recruiter@talentbridge.co>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Hourglass: coding screen — proposed windows and ops

Hi Sophia (and team),

Thanks for taking the time — we'd like to lock in a 60-minute coding + system-design-lite screen. Proposed windows (all PST):
- Option A: Tue 25 May, 10:30–11:30
- Option B: Wed 26 May, 14:00–15:00
- Option C: Thu 27 May, 08:30–09:30

Operational details:
- Primary environment: CoderPad (link below). We'll use the live pad for a 35–40 minute problem, then 10–15 min for system/design q’s and wrap.
- Fallback: shared GitHub gist + Google Meet if CoderPad has issues.
- Interviewers: Marcus (coding lead) and Kimberly (ML/arch). Marcus will own the rubrics.

Attachments: tech-screen-template.pdf (short checklist for interviewers) and Sophia's profile (copied from recruiter).

Sophia — please confirm which window works and whether you prefer macOS or Linux environment (we can set the pad accordingly). Marcus/Kim — if you see any conflicts please flag.

Links:
CoderPad: https://coderpad.io/session/abcd-1234
Google Meet (fallback): https://meet.google.com/xyz-meet
Candidate record: https://hireflow.internal.redwood/candidate/SZ-7732

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Recruiter (Hiring Lead) — Redwood Inference

Cc: TalentBridge Recruiter <recruiter@talentbridge.co>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Hourglass: coding screen — proposed windows and ops

Hi Karthik — thanks for the options. I can do Option B (Wed 26 May, 14:00–15:00 PST). I usually code on macOS but I can switch to Linux if that makes grading easier.

A couple quick questions:
1) Will there be any take-home beforehand?
2) Is there a whiteboard portion or just code in the pad?

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Sophia
(sophia.zheng@gmail.com)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophia Zheng <sophia.zheng@example.com>, TalentBridge Recruiter <recruiter@talentbridge.co>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:01:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Hourglass: coding screen — confirmed slot + ops notes

Thanks Sophia — confirming Wed 26 May, 14:00–15:00 PST. No take-home; it's fully live in CoderPad. Small design prompt at the end (no whiteboard tool required).

Marcus/Kim — please accept the calendar invite (I sent it) and note the debrief window immediately following (15:05–15:20). The plan is:
- 14:00–14:05 quick intros
- 14:05–14:45 coding problem (Marcus to lead)
- 14:45–14:55 design/discussion (Kim to lead)
- 14:55–15:00 closing and candidate questions

I attached the candidate profile (sophia_profile.pdf) and the interviewer checklist (tech-screen-template.pdf). After the interview please fill the debrief rubric: debrief-rubric.xlsx (link also below).

If CoderPad is unresponsive, call the fallback Meet link and paste the pad in chat. I'll run proctoring from my side (screen recording allowed per candidate consent).

Debrief form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf-debrief
Candidate record: https://hireflow.internal.redwood/candidate/SZ-7732

Karthik

Got it — I accepted the invite. No conflicts for me.

I'll prepare the easier warmup then escalate difficulty; aim is to finish core work by 40 minutes so we have time for design.

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:22:00 -0000
Subject: Post-interview debrief plan & rubric reminder

Team — quick heads up for after the interview tomorrow: please join the 15:05–15:20 debrief immediately after the session (5–10 minutes per interviewer). If you can't join, fill the rubric by EOD.

A couple of grading reminders (from the template):
- Correctness & test coverage (0–4)
- Problem approach & clarity (0–4)
- Performance & tradeoffs (0–3)
- Communication & collaboration (0–3)
- Recommend hire? (Yes/No/Maybe)

Debrief rubric link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1debrief-rubric
Attached: debrief-rubric.xlsx (brief scoring sheet).

Also noting candidate consent for screen recording is in hireflow record.

Thanks — see you tomorrow,
Karthik
